basis: Compatibility with the actual pinned Read paged footer observed in capacity-component-v4; complete source delivery remains mandatory

cases.expect: accept an exact Showing lines footer with canonical positive integers, matching declared offset, contiguous returned rows, final row, larger total and next offset end+1; exclude footer from content
reject wrong start, end, total, next offset, noncanonical integers, duplicate footer, mixed footer and rows after footer
reject duplicate or missing numbered rows inside a claimed paged range and undeclared row ranges
a valid partial page alone cannot satisfy complete delivery; every original source line must remain present and byte-equal
the exact saved capacity-v4 pre-first-mutation request passes the shared information guard; dropping a mandatory view still rejects
